headline: Big gain keeps the Chiefs moving
what_happened: P.Mahomes completed a pass to K.Walker for 22 yards, which gives the Chiefs a first down to earn a fresh set of four tries.
who: P.Mahomes threw the ball to K.Walker.
why_it_matters: This is great news for the Chiefs! This big play moved the team much closer to scoring and increased their chances of winning the game by 24 percent.
